I have been farming maize here in Rukwa for many years. This plot is 2.59 hectares and I grow maize because the rains are good and the soil is decent in the Southern Highlands. I will buy a few bags of fertilizer from the market and use improved seed because they give better yields than local seed. My family will do most of the planting, weeding, and harvesting, but I will hire some workers from the village when the work is heavy, especially during land preparation and weeding. I do not irrigate because the rains are enough here, and I do not spray chemicals on maize.
